subject.title: fix: persist queued iOS watch replies

question: Should this PR require real iPhone/Apple Watch quick-reply proof before merge, or may maintainers explicitly accept source, Swift tests, CI, and Testbox evidence with device validation deferred?
rationale: The source-level fix is in the right owner boundary, but repository policy treats external user-visible transport/runtime behavior proof as a merge gate and the PR discussion says physical Watch proof was unavailable.

options.title: Require Watch reply proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted simulator or physical iPhone/Apple Watch run showing a queued quick reply surviving reconnect or restart and sending to the original gateway exactly once.

options.title: Accept the proof gap
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge after rebase using source/tests/CI and carry Watch round-trip validation as a release-testing risk.

options.title: Pause for branch refresh
options.body: Wait for a clean rebase or reconstructed branch before deciding whether the proof gap is acceptable.

recommendation.title: Require Watch reply proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted simulator or physical iPhone/Apple Watch run showing a queued quick reply surviving reconnect or restart and sending to the original gateway exactly once.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned, authored the hardening commits, and already documented the proof gap on the PR.
